row: 巴西 聖保羅州 聖保羅
科潘大樓位於聖保羅市中心，由奧斯卡．尼邁耶設計，1966 年落成，高 115 公尺、32 層，共有 1,160 戶，以 S 形曲面與水平遮陽板聞名，擁有專屬郵遞區號。

airspace.zh: 在巴西飛行空拍機須遵守巴西民航局（ANAC）與空域管理（DECEA）規定；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Drones in Brazil fall under ANAC and DECEA rules. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

curve.en: The curved façade of the Copan

shs.note: halfway along the noon shadow on 21 June

tagline.zh-Hant: 尼邁耶的 S 形住宅：1,160 戶與專屬郵遞區號
tagline.en: Niemeyer's S-shaped block: 1,160 homes and a postal code of its own

zh: 巴西聖保羅市中心，一棟彎成 S 形的大樓，
就是科潘大樓。
en: In the centre of São Paulo, Brazil, a building curves in an S:
the Edifício Copan.

zh: 由建築師奧斯卡．尼邁耶設計，
en: It was designed by the architect Oscar Niemeyer
and completed in 1966: 115 m tall, with 32 floors.

zh: 流線形的外牆，由一道道水平的遮陽板組成；
這片曲面外牆，由尼邁耶親自設計。
en: The flowing façade is made of rows of horizontal sun-breakers;
Niemeyer himself was responsible for this curved façade.

zh: 整棟共有 1,160 戶，從小套房到三房都有；
住戶多到巴西郵政給了它專屬的郵遞區號。
en: There are 1,160 apartments, from studios to three bedrooms;
so many people live here that the Brazilian post gave it its own postal code.

zh: 總樓地板面積約 12 萬平方公尺，
被稱為巴西最大的鋼筋混凝土結構。
en: Its floors add up to about 120,000 square metres;
it is described as the largest reinforced-concrete structure in Brazil.

zh: 日照：12 月 21 日是南半球的夏至，
中午太陽幾乎在正頭頂，大樓幾乎沒有影子。
en: Sun and shade: 21 December is the southern summer solstice;
at noon the sun is almost straight overhead and the building casts almost no shadow.

zh: 6 月 21 日的冬至中午，太陽仰角約 43 度，
影子向南拉長，約 120 公尺。
en: At noon on the winter solstice, 21 June, the sun is about 43° up,
and the shadow stretches about 120 m to the south.

banner.zh: 虛構的示意樣品屋・非實際格局
banner.en: Fictional mock-up flat · not an actual layout

zh: 以下是虛構的示意樣品屋，約在 90 公尺高，
窗戶面向北方，望向聖保羅的市中心。
en: What follows is a fictional mock-up flat, about 90 m up,
with its windows facing north across central São Paulo.

banner.zh: 虛構的示意樣品屋・非實際格局
banner.en: Fictional mock-up flat · not an actual layout

zh: 冬天的傍晚，夕陽從西邊斜照，
市中心的高樓一棟棟染成金色。
en: On a winter evening the sun slants in from the west,
turning the towers of the centre gold one by one.

zh: 一樓是有 72 家店的商店街，
大樓裡有 20 部電梯，住著兩千多人。
en: The ground floor is a shopping arcade of 72 businesses;
twenty lifts serve more than two thousand residents.

zh: 它在 1950 年代開工，中間幾度停工，
1966 年完成，成了巴西現代建築的象徵。
en: Work began in the 1950s and stopped more than once;
completed in 1966, it became a symbol of modern Brazilian architecture.

zh: 本片為示意畫面：建築為簡化模型，樣品屋為虛構，
非建商官方資料、非廣告；日照依當天計算。
en: Illustration: the buildings are simplified models and the flat is fictional;
not developer material or an advertisement. The light follows that day's sun.
